introHtml: For coffee lovers who need a full liter of their favorite brew, custom 40 oz coffee mugs offer the ultimate capacity. These oversized mugs are ideal for warehouse workers, truck drivers, or anyone who wants fewer refills during a long day. With a wide mouth for easy cleaning and ample surface area for full-color logos or detailed text, they make a bold statement. Choose from ceramic or stainless steel options, and decorate with screen printing, pad printing, or full-wrap dye sublimation for maximum brand visibility.
